name: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Clark
short_description: A half marathon series race set for August 23, 2026 at Filinvest Mimosa, Clark, Philippines, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Clark is a road race scheduled for August 23, 2026, at Filinvest Mimosa in Clark, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series brand, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, with the half marathon serving as the primary distance. Registration is currently open for runners interested in participating.

core_facts.organizer: Runrio (brand: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series)

pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) accommodate different runner levels
Registration is currently open, giving runners time to prepare and sign up
Organized by Runrio, an established name behind the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series
Held at Filinvest Mimosa, a dedicated venue in Clark, Philippines
cons: No pricing, course, or amenity details are available in the provided facts
research_highlights: The Clark leg takes place at Filinvest Mimosa+ in Clark Freeport Zone, Angeles, Pampanga, with 21K, 10K, and 5K distance options offered at every city stop in the series.

All registered participants receive official PUMA race singlets and city-specific finisher medals, with an additional 'All-City Finisher Legacy Medal' for those who complete all six legs of the series (Iloilo, Davao, Cebu, Clark, Cagayan de Oro, Manila).
Only water is confirmed at hydration stations along the route; no mention of on-course gels/electrolytes was found.
Walkers are permitted but are asked to keep to the right so faster runners can pass; wheelchairs, bikes, skates, and strollers are not allowed on course.
The awarding ceremony is held on race day at Filinvest Mimosa immediately after the race, per the organizer's FAQ.
research_watchouts: Registration is explicitly non-transferable and non-refundable, and organizers state that changes in event category or leg/city are not allowed after signing up.
Parking availability at the Clark venue is listed as 'TBA' in the official FAQ, so attendees are advised to check official announcements closer to race day rather than assume on-site parking.
Runners who do not start within 15 minutes of their assigned flag-off time are disqualified and may not be allowed to start, per the race mechanics document.

As this is only the second running of the Clark leg (first held December 2025) and the search turned up no independent participant race reports or reviews, there is little first-hand feedback yet on actual course/heat/crowd conditions for this specific leg.
